orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Lumen "Ion Drive", a hull mount (outward is up): a stack of three ion rings outside, widest at the nozzle on top, the light running up them (cyan lit core, magenta pins) and a cyan glow with a magenta halo streaming out above; a navy collar with cyan edge lines; inside a slim navy core with a lens crystal accumulator, a display, a repair hatch and a cyan-ringed power coupling. Damaged: the middle ring has slipped out of line and cracked, arcs jump the gap, the lens crystal is cracked and flickers. Disabled: the top ring snapped half off and hanging, the collar cracked, the lens shattered, every line dead. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
